args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. A cute COSMIC JELLYFISH: a translucent pink-violet jelly dome with tiny white star sparkles inside it, a happy little face with two dot eyes and a smile, and four short wavy tentacles hanging below. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size and all on the same invisible ground line, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. Frames: (1)-(6) a bobbing swim cycle: the dome squashing wide and short at the bottom of the bob, then stretching tall at the top, tentacles trailing with a lag; (7)-(8) giggling with a bigger open smile and the dome wobbling. Each jellyfish is about 30 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
